([[Saly, Senegal]]) | career_start = 2022 | draft_year = 2024 | draft_round = 2 | draft_pick = 57 | draft_team = [[Memphis Grizzlies]] | years1 = [[2022 BAL season|2022]] | team1 = [[FAP Basketball|FAP]] | years2 = [[2023 BAL season|2023]] | team2 = [[REG BBC|REG]] | years3 = {{nbay|2024|full=y}} | team3 =[[Toronto Raptors]] | years4 = [[2024–25 NBA G League season|2024–2025]] | team4 = →[[Raptors 905]] | years5 = 2026–present | team5 = [[BC Balkan Botevgrad|Balkan Botevgrad]] | highlights = * [[Nike Hoop Summit]] (2024) }} '''Ulrich Kamka Chomche''' (born 30 December 2005) is a Cameroonian professional [[basketball]] player for [[BC Balkan Botevgrad|Balkan Botevgrad]] of the Bulgarian [[National Basketball League (Bulgaria)|National Basketball League]] (NBL) and the [[EuroCup Basketball|EuroCup]]. At 6 ft 11 in (2.11 m), he plays the [[Center (basketball)|center]] position. A graduate of the [[NBA Academy Africa]], Chomche is the first former [[Basketball Africa League]] (BAL) player to be drafted into the NBA. He has been labeled by ''[[ESPN]]'' as the best Cameroonian prospect of his generation, and the best since [[Joel Embiid]].{{cite web|title=Cameroon's best prospect since Embiid? Ulrich Chomche is Him|url=https://www.espn.com/espn/story/_/id/35878211/cameroon-best-prospect-joel-embiid-wonderkid-ulrich-chomche-him|website=ESPN.com|date=17 March 2023|access-date=27 March 2023}} ==Early life== Chomche was born in [[Bafang]], in the [[West Region (Cameroon)|West Province]] of Cameroon, and picked up basketball at age 11 due to peer pressure because he was the tallest kid in his neighborhood. One year later, he joined the [[NBA Academy Africa]] in [[Saly]], [[Senegal]] and started studying English. Chomche played at the 2022 [[Basketball Without Borders]] camp in [[Cairo]] and was named the Defensive MVP among boys at the camp.{{cite web|title=Egyptian Elalfy and Darlan of CAF named BWB Africa camp MVPs|url=https://www.fiba.basketball/news/egyptian-elalfy-and-darlan-of-caf-named-bwb-africa-camp-mvps|website=FIBA.basketball|access-date=27 March 2023}} ==Professional career== ===FAP (2022)=== Chomche made his debut in the [[Basketball Africa League]] (BAL) at age 16 in 2022, playing for Cameroonian club [[FAP Basketball|FAP]] under the BAL Elevate program. This program allocated players from the [[NBA Academy Africa]] to professional teams. He averaged 2.1 points and 3.7 rebounds in 11.3 minutes per game,{{cite web|title=Ulurich Chomche Player Profile, REG - RealGM|url=https://basketball.realgm.com/player/Ulurich-Chomche/Summary/155584|website=RealGm.com|access-date=27 March 2023}} and was part of FAP's run to fourth place.{{cite web|title=Cameroon: FAP Basketballer Ulrich Chomche Writing His Story One Step At A Time - PAN AFRICAN VISIONS|url=https://panafricanvisions.com/2022/08/cameroon-fap-basketballer-ulrich-chomche-writing-his-story-one-step-at-a-time/|website=PanAfricanVisions.com|date=15 August 2022|access-date=27 March 2023}} On 16 April, he grabbed a career-high seven rebounds against [[Petro de Luanda (basketball)|Petro de Luanda]]. ===REG (2023)=== The next year, in [[2023 BAL season|2023]], Chomche was drafted by the Rwandan team [[REG BBC|REG]] to play in his second consecutive BAL season. During the tournament, he received praise from former NBA player [[Joakim Noah]]. In March 2024, Chomche was drafted by Rwandan club [[APR BBC|APR]] for the [[2024 BAL season]].{{cite web|title=Top NBA Draft prospects land on new BAL teams|url=https://www.espn.com/espn/story/_/id/39651148/top-nba-draft-prospects-ulrich-chomche-khaman-maluach-land-bal-teams-2024-season|website=ESPN.com|date=4 March 2024|access-date=15 March 2024}} He was eventually left off of the roster to prepare for the [[2024 NBA draft]].{{cite web|title=NBA Draft prep lures Chomche away from BAL|url=https://www.espn.com/espn/story/_/id/40081043/ulrich-chomche-left-apr-bal-roster-receives-nba-draft-combine-invite|website=ESPN.com|date=7 May 2024|access-date=7 May 2024}} ===Toronto Raptors / Raptors 905 (2024–2025)=== On 15 April 2024, Chomche declared for the [[2024 NBA draft]].{{cite web|title=NBA Academy Africa center Ulrich Chomche declares for 2024 NBA draft|url=https://sports.yahoo.com/nba-academy-africa-center-ulrich-034043975.html|work=Yahoo Sports|date=16 April 2024|access-date=16 April 2024}} He was the youngest player in the draft.{{cite web|title=NBA 2024 Draft Prospects {{!}} Ulrich Chomche {{!}} NBA.com|url=https://www.nba.com/draft/2024/prospects/ulrich-chomche#:~:text=Chomche%20is%20the%20youngest%20player,with%20the%20NBA%20Academy%20Africa.|website=NBA.com|access-date=30 June 2024}} On 27 June 2024, Chomche was selected with the 57th overall pick by the [[Memphis Grizzlies]] in the [[2024 NBA draft]], however, immediately on draft night, he was traded to the [[Toronto Raptors]].{{cite web|title=Raptors select Ulrich Chomche 57th overall after trade with Timberwolves|url=https://www.sportsnet.ca/nba/article/raptors-select-ulrich-chomche-57th-overall-after-trade-with-timberwolves/|website=SportsNet.ca|date=27 June 2024|access-date=28 June 2024}} He became the first [[NBA Academy Africa]] prospect to be drafted, as well as the first player to be drafted directly out of any NBA Academy. He is also the first former BAL player to be selected.{{cite web|title=Historic NBA Draft night for Cameroon's Ulrich Chomche, Missi|url=https://www.fiba.basketball/news/historic-nba-draft-night-for-cameroons-ulrich-chomche-missi|website=FIBA.basketball|access-date=30 June 2024}} On 10 July, he signed a [[two-way contract]] with the Raptors.{{cite web|title=RAPTORS SIGN CHOMCHE TO TWO-WAY CONTRACT|url=https://www.nba.com/raptors/news/raptors-sign-chomche-to-two-way-contract|website=NBA.com|date=10 July 2024|access-date=19 July 2024}} In seven games for Toronto, Chomche averaged 0.7 points, 1.1 rebounds, and 0.3 assists. On 19 February 2025, Chomche was ruled out for the remainder of the season after suffering a partial proximal [[medial collateral ligament|MCL]] tear in his right knee.{{cite web | title=Raptors' Ulrich Chomche out for season with MCL tear | website=Sportsnet.ca | date=2025-02-19 | url=https://www.sportsnet.ca/nba/article/raptors-ulrich-chomche-out-for-season-with-mcl-tear/ | access-date=2025-12-06}} On 16 October 2025, he was waived by Toronto.{{cite web|title=RAPTORS WAIVE FIVE PLAYERS|url=https://www.nba.com/raptors/news/raptors-waive-five-players|website=NBA.com|date=16 October 2025|access-date=17 October 2025}} ===Balkan Botevgrad (2026–present)=== On 13 August 2026, Chomche signed with [[BC Balkan Botevgrad|Balkan Botevgrad]] of the Bulgarian [[National Basketball League (Bulgaria)|National Basketball League]] (NBL).{{Cite web|title=Balkan bets on Cameroonian center Ulrich Chomche|url=https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/en/eurocup/news/balkan-bets-on-cameroonian-center-ulrich-chomche/|date=13 August 2026|website=euroleaguebasketball.net|access-date=20 August 2026}} ==National team career== In February 2023, Chomche was first selected for the [[Cameroon men's national basketball team|Cameroon senior national team]] for the [[2023 FIBA Basketball World Cup qualification|2023 World Cup qualifiers]].{{cite web|title=Final rosters confirmed ahead of Window 6 of the 2023 African Qualifiers|url=https://www.fiba.basketball/basketballworldcup/2023/african-qualifiers/news/final-rosters-confirmed-ahead-of-window-6-of-the-2023-african-qualifiers|website=FIBA.basketball|access-date=27 March 2023}} He made his debut on 24 February 2023 in [[Alexandria]], playing eight minutes in an 85–56 win over [[DR Congo men's national basketball team|DR Congo]].{{cite web|title=Cameroon v Congo DR boxscore - FIBA Basketball World Cup 2023 African Qualifiers - 24 February|url=https://www.fiba.basketball/basketballworldcup/2023/african-qualifiers/game/2402/Cameroon-Congo-DR|website=FIBA.basketball|access-date=27 March 2023}}{{cite web|title=FIBA Basketball World Cup 2023 African Qualifiers|url=https://www.fiba.basketball/basketballworldcup/2023/african-qualifiers/player/Ulrich-Kamka-Chomche|website=FIBA.basketball|access-date=27 March 2023}} ==Player profile== Standing at {{Height|ft=6|in=11}} with a {{Height|ft=7|in=4}} wingspan, Chomche is best at the defensive end of the court and has been praised for his defensive and shot blocking abilities.
